items.caption:
Satya Nadella says he was wrong about AI alignment.

Back in 2018-2019 he believed in scaling laws and assumed alignment would just fall out of them. He no longer believes that, and now thinks alignment may be a harder, different problem.

Is alignment the hardest problem in AI right now?

Source: 20VC with Harry Stebbings, Satya Nadella on Open vs Closed Models. Full video: youtube.com/watch?v=24XUcWhqY_4

items.caption:
Satya Nadella says every company will have a private eval benchmark, and it will be their core IP.

His view: every model comes in and tries to hill climb on that eval, and that is how a firm will work.

What would your company’s private benchmark measure?

items.caption:
Satya Nadella thinks calling yourself “AI native” will be passé in five years.

He compares it to cloud: early on everyone asked who was cloud native, and now everybody is. Even Lloyd’s, roughly 500 years old, is cloud native.

Will “AI native” still mean anything in 2030?
